$comment: Budgets for the tx402 core import path. Authority: ADR-008.
ownCodeGzipBytes is RELEASE-BLOCKING and does not move. It measures only the code tx402
itself emits, treating @x402/core, zod, and every chain adapter as external. 25 KiB = 25600.
totalCorePathGzipBytes is a tracking ceiling, re-baselined only by an ADR-008 amendment that
records the measurement and the milestone. M1 froze 24 KiB, M2 amended to 28 KiB, and the M3
amendment sets 30 KiB from a measured 28.39 KiB core. The M5 amendment sets 32 KiB from a
measured 30.55 KiB core (route planner + health index). It is frozen for good at M8.
Chain adapters (tx402/evm, tx402/solana) are measured and reported separately and are
excluded from both figures, consistent with the SPEC §12.3 carve-out. That exclusion covers
the lazy import() targets in src/core/chain.ts, which a real bundler code-splits.
